verdict.rationale: The docs establish a Provider package model that connects Crossplane to external APIs (docs-10, docs-22) and claim it can manage any resource anywhere, with existing managed resources and a component library (docs-20, docs-23, docs-27). Only AWS RDS is shown concretely (docs-3), and community comments support multi-cloud portability only in general terms (comm-3, comm-4). missing for 10: concrete evidence of providers for GCP, Azure and SaaS services, documentation of the provider registry's size and breadth, and independent hands-on corroboration of multi-provider use.
